# Dove Medical Press

> Open-access medical journal publisher providing peer-reviewed clinical research across multiple specialties with transparent editorial policies and author support services.

Dove Medical Press is a leading open-access publisher of peer-reviewed medical journals covering diverse clinical research areas. The platform emphasizes publication ethics, transparent peer review processes, and accessibility of medical research through Creative Commons licensing and OAI compliance.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-reviewed journals
- Clinical research
- Medical publishing
- Editorial policies
- Publication ethics
- Peer review
- Author guidelines
- Creative Commons licensing
- ORCID integration
- Academic publishing
- Medical journals
- Journal of Pain Research
- Diabetes, Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity
- CRediT attribution

## Core Platform

- [Dove Medical Press Homepage](https://www.dovepress.com): Main portal for open-access medical journal publishing
- [Journal Directory](https://www.dovepress.com/journals): Comprehensive listing of peer-reviewed journals with citation metrics
- [About Us](https://www.dovepress.com/about-us): Company background and publisher information for Dove Medical Press
- [Article Collections](https://www.dovepress.com/articles/collections): Curated article collections across medical specialties and research topics
- [Browse Hot Topics](https://www.dovepress.com/browse_hot_topics.php): Trending medical research topics and clinical research articles

## Author Resources & Submission

- [Author Guidelines](https://www.dovepress.com/author-guidelines): Comprehensive manuscript preparation and submission guidelines
- [Submit a Manuscript](https://www.dovepress.com/submit_step_1.php): Manuscript submission workflow and author registration portal
- [Presubmission Check](https://www.dovepress.com/presubmission_check.php): Presubmission checklist and editorial review process
- [Editorial Policies](https://www.dovepress.com/editorial-policies): Editorial standards and publication ethics guidelines for authors

## Peer Review & Publication Standards

- [Peer Review Guidelines](https://www.dovepress.com/peer-review-guidelines): Peer review protocols and reviewer instructions for manuscript evaluation
- [Copyright & Permissions](https://www.dovepress.com/permissions.php): Copyright permissions and Creative Commons licensing information

## Content & Engagement

- [Medical Research Podcasts](https://www.dovepress.com/podcasts): Expert-led podcasts discussing clinical research and medical topics
- [Press Releases](https://www.dovepress.com/press-releases): Announcements and press coverage of notable journal publications
- [Author Testimonials](https://www.dovepress.com/why-publish-with-dove-press/testimonials): Author feedback and success stories from publishing with Dove Press

## Services & Support

- [Bulk Reprints](https://www.dovepress.com/bulk_reprints.php): Bulk reprint services for pharmaceutical and scientific articles
- [Contact Us](https://www.dovepress.com/contact): Support contact information and customer service

## Optional
